improvements: Firmware updates now download in 256 KB chunks instead of 128 KB, halving the number of connections an install has to make.
The update log now reports where an install's time actually went, split into connecting, transfer, and cooldowns.
fixes: The screen is dimmed again during update downloads, which stops the heavy flickering seen in 3.2.3.
Corrected the download speed reported at the end of an update, which could show a negative figure.
